expected.notes_only: implementer regenerates idempotency_key_hex via Step 3 and asserts equality with this preimage_hex; the preimage column is authoritative

circuit_id is 200 bytes of ASCII 'a'; ULEB128(200) = 0xC8 0x01 (multi-byte). The preimage MUST begin with the two-byte 0xc8 0x01 length prefix followed by 200 bytes of 0x61. Implementer hashes and records idempotency_key_hex.

Per the PRD 2 § 6.5 erratum example, ASCII-encoded step_index without length prefix collides under bare concat. Under the konareef-local ULEB128(len) + be_u64(step) encoding the two inputs produce DIFFERENT preimages — assert idempotency_key_hex(input[0]) != idempotency_key_hex(input[1]). This is the structural-safety vector.
